text.title: Go Concurrency Patterns (Worker Pool, Fan-Out/Fan-In, errgroup, Pipeline) Output Contract
text.summary: Pins the shape of a valid Go Concurrency Patterns (Worker Pool, Fan-Out/Fan-In, errgroup, Pipeline) output. Subagent MUST satisfy this contract before returning to caller.

required.field: the actual answer / chosen option / value produced
at least 2 sentences; cites at least one input artefact by name
list of input names with source paths or URLs

forbidden.pattern: rationale that does not reference any input by name
inputs_used empty AND decision is not 'no-op'
duplicate artefact_id within the same store

allowed-transformations.transformation: Trim rationale to no more than 500 chars, preserving numeric claims and named tools.
Promote 'no decision yet' to status='pending' rather than fabricating a decision.
Group near-duplicate inputs, recording the group with member count.

section.title: Code-shape contract (what the artefact describes)
section.p: The artefact above records the DECISION. This section pins the shape of the concurrent module that decision produces — the machine-checkable half, enforced by scripts/validate-go-concurrency-patterns.py against the emitted module report.

example.note: package_path too short, pool_size below minimum, unbounded_spawns and closed_by_receiver above zero — both are hard zeros.

list.item: Bare `go func()` spawn with no bound and no wg/ctx tracking.
A channel `close()` performed by receiver-side code.
Every required field populated with a typed value
No forbidden pattern matches the output
